name: Users
descr: The people of the shop, the groups they stand in and the rights they hold - a right is an operation of the oper tree, handed to a person or to a group. A password is never a field of a call: it is born in the tool, kept as md5 and said once. What a person did in the shop keeps their id, so one who carries history is blocked rather than deleted.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the people and the groups they stand in - two tables. The tree of the operations and the rights given out come with CmdListFull. The password of a person is answered by neither: it is kept as md5 and said once, when it is made.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the people and their groups together with the tree of the operations, the rights given out and the tables every operation touches - five tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a person. There is no password field: the tool makes one, keeps its md5 only and says the password once in the answer - hand it over, advise to change it, store it nowhere. Rights are given out with CmdRightAdd.

params.name: login
params.descr: what the person types to get in: latin letters, digits and underscore, and nobody else has it

params.name: name
params.descr: the name the people of the shop see

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group they stand in - the rights come by it

params.name: add_group_id
params.descr: id of a second group, when they stand in two

params.name: phone
params.descr: the phone of the person

params.name: email
params.descr: the email of the person

params.name: params
params.descr: the parameters of the person, as the program keeps them

params.name: is_blocked
params.descr: true - they cannot get in; the history of what they did stays

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of people, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was. A login changes for one person at a time, and blocking is here too: is_blocked.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the person, or several of them

params.name: login
params.descr: what the person types to get in: latin letters, digits and underscore, and nobody else has it

params.name: name
params.descr: the name the people of the shop see

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group they stand in - the rights come by it

params.name: add_group_id
params.descr: id of a second group, when they stand in two

params.name: phone
params.descr: the phone of the person

params.name: email
params.descr: the email of the person

params.name: params
params.descr: the parameters of the person, as the program keeps them

params.name: is_blocked
params.descr: true - they cannot get in; the history of what they did stays

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes people by id, with the rows of their rights. A person who carries history - tasks, notes, memory - is refused: block them instead. The person of this session is refused too.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the person, or several of them

commands.name: CmdPassword
commands.descr: Makes a new password for one person, said once and kept as md5 only. The old one stops working at once.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the person

commands.name: CmdGroupAdd
commands.descr: Adds a group of people at the end of the list. Its rights are given out with CmdRightAdd.

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the group

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: phone
params.descr: the phone of the group

params.name: email
params.descr: the email of the group

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdGroupUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of groups, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the group

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: phone
params.descr: the phone of the group

params.name: email
params.descr: the email of the group

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list

commands.name: CmdGroupRemove
commands.descr: Deletes groups by id, with the rows of their rights. A group that people still stand in is refused - move them out of it first.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rights given to these groups go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdGroupPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the groups in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdRightAdd
commands.descr: Grants an operation to a person or to a group, one of the two - the other stays empty. A right by group reaches everyone whose group_id or add_group_id it is. The person with id 1 holds every operation without a single row here, and the oper tree itself belongs to the engine: no tool writes it.

params.name: oper_id
params.descr: id of the operation, from the oper table of CmdList

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person the right goes to; empty when it goes to a group

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group the right goes to; empty when it goes to a person

commands.name: CmdRightUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the right rows, by id. A right does not move from a person to a group: take it back and give it out anew.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the right row, or several of them

params.name: oper_id
params.descr: id of the operation, from the oper table of CmdList

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person the right goes to; empty when it goes to a group

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group the right goes to; empty when it goes to a person

commands.name: CmdRightRemove
commands.descr: Takes rights back by id. The other rights of those people stay.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the right row, or several of them

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on people: one row of user_key_set on every person named. The options themselves are declared in the registry of the additional options, place user, and that tool answers their tree.

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option the row stands on

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the value written by hand, when the option keeps no list

params.name: id

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the value written by hand

commands.name: CmdKeyRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of user_key_set by id. The option itself stays in its tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row, or several of them

commands.name: CmdGroupKeyAdd
